review: Independent actual-trace scope, CUDA-correlation and interval-union recomputation
limitations: Ten profiled calls per shape/mode/rank do not replace the unprofiled primary protocol or establish six independent repetitions
Stage sums include overlap; same-stream PDL does not imply serial kernel execution
Maximum per-rank span is not an aligned cross-rank end-to-end latency and excludes external TP barriers
Publish duration includes local selection; merge duration includes tag polling and reduction; neither isolates pure link transfer latency
No NVLink bandwidth, direct spin-cycle count or inter-node communication was measured
K_fixed is the explicitly corrected historical package with its companion vLLM, not H or the original unfixed K
